subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should Control UI channel viewing stop at the current Sessions-table Group by channel behavior, or should OpenClaw add a first-class separated/merged channel timeline toggle?
rationale: Current main partially covers channel organization, but choosing merged transcript semantics and separated tab UX requires maintainer product and Gateway/session boundary intent.

options.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
options.body: Define separated view, merged timeline, routing, and privacy semantics before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Enough
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers decide current Group by channel plus per-session chat links is the intended Control UI surface.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining work under the broader sessions workspace issue if maintainers want one design to own channel views too.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
recommendation.body: Define separated view, merged timeline, routing, and privacy semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current-main implementation came through recent Control UI session grouping work, so this is the best available product-direction owner from history.
